### Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template: `DATA_ROOT` is the results directory given to `depictio ingest`, the others are set with `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | Root directory of one rnavar run (reports/, variant_calling/, annotation/, pipeline_info/). |
| `METADATA_FILE` | — | Optional design table (TSV): sample id in a column named sample (or in the first column), one column per factor such as a cell line or condition. Joined into the sample hub: enables the design filters, the group colours and the group splits. |
| `METADATA_ID_COL` | — | Design table sample-id column. Auto-detected as the first column; defaults to 'sample'. |
| `GROUP_COL` | — | Design column the dashboards group and filter samples by. Auto-detected as the first factor column of METADATA_FILE. |
| `GENOME` | — | UCSC name of the assembly the run was aligned to (hg38, mm10): the axis and gene lane of the Genome tab. Use none for an assembly without chr-prefixed contigs. |
| `TRACKS_URI` | — | s3:// or https:// folder holding the run's results (the folder DATA_ROOT mirrors), to read the genome-browser tracks (VCF, BAM) in place instead of uploading them from DATA_ROOT. |

**Auto-detected** (set from the run's metadata / `params.json`; the route flags drive *Conditional routes* below): `GROUP_COL_DISPLAY`, `ANNOTATION_COLS`

### Conditional routes

Rows are data collections; columns are the variables you set or `params.json` flags auto-detected from the run. Each filled cell is the effect of **setting** that variable; an **empty cell** means that variable leaves the collection unchanged. ### Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `OUTPUT_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`nf-core/rnavar/allele_fractions.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/rnavar/recipes/allele_fractions.py) | nf-core/rnavar allele-fraction distribution: each sample's PASS calls over the allele fraction. | `sample`, `variant_type`, `depth_class`, `vaf_bin`, `vaf`, `calls` |
